scripts.build: npm run assets:build && node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs deploy --dry-run -c wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply arcade-catalog --local -c wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.db:seed: npm run catalog:generate && node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs d1 execute arcade-catalog --local --file=db/seed.sql -c wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.deploy:production: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/deploy-preflight.ts --production && npm run assets:build && node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs deploy -c wrangler.jsonc
